sentences.text:
By way of this petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C, petitioner is seeking setting aside of the order dated 12.04.2023 passed by learned ASJ whereby learned ASJ dismissed the bail application bearing no. 492/2023 under Section 439(2) seeking modification of the order dated 25.01.2023 and further dismissed the bail application bearing no.240/2023 of the petitioner seeking permission to go abroad to join his duties in case FIR No. 315/2022, P.S. Kalindi Kunj, registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC Since FIR No.315/2022, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC,
registered at Police Station Kalindi Kunj, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom has been quashed, no nothing survives in this petition, and the same has become infructuous and disposed of accordingly.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J MAY 16, 2023/ib
